blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Parallel drafters such as DFlash and DSpark reduce proposal latency, but early mismatches limit how much of each block can be accepted. Retaining alternatives introduces parent states and candidate choices that reference-conditioned training does not directly supervise. We introduce TreeSpark, a unified training and inference framework extending the semi-autoregressive DSpark architecture. It constructs parent-conditioned candidate trees from one backbone pass and replays their expansion, pruning, and budgeted packing during training. Survival negative log-likelihood weights retained edges by reference-derived path mass, while a capped coverage hinge promotes target-important alternatives near local selection boundaries. Both objectives reuse reference-chain target distributions without additional target forward passes. We evaluate greedy decoding with Qwen3-4B and Qwen3-8B on nine general benchmarks and six writing domains. Across targets and suites, TreeSpark improves mean acceptance length over DSpark by 23.4% to 31.6% and mean single-request throughput by 15.1% to 25.0%. Batched Qwen3-4B throughput improves by 12.6% to 17.2%. At fixed attention capacity and inference policy, the proposed supervision further improves mean acceptance length by approximately 6.4% and mean system throughput by 4.2% to 5.0% on Qwen3-4B.
blocks.zh: DFlash和DSpark等并行的起草者减少了提案的延迟性,但早期的不匹配限制了每个块可以接受多少. 保留替代方案将引入母体国家和候选人的选择,而参照条件的培训并不直接监督。 我们引入了 TreeSpark,一个统一的培训和推论框架,扩展了半自动的DSpark架构. 它从一个主干证上搭建有父母条件的候选树,并在训练期间重新播放其扩展、刷新和预算包装。 存活负对数的负负重通过参考来源路径质量保留边缘,而封面覆盖则在局部选择边界附近促进目标重要替代品。 这两项目标都重复使用参考链目标分布,没有额外的目标前行通行证。 我们评价贪婪的解码与Quen3-4B和Quen3-8B在9个一般基准和6个写字域. 在整个目标和套房中,TreatySpark的接收长度比DSpark提高了23.4%至31.6%,平均单项请求吞吐量提高了15.1%至25.0%。 抽取Qwen3-4B吞吐量提高12.6%至17.2%. 在固定注意力能力和推论政策方面,拟议的监督进一步提高了平均接受时间长度约6.4%,在Qune3-4B上的平均系统吞吐量为4.2%至5.0%。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Speculative decoding reduces the sequential cost of language model inference by separating inexpensive proposal generation from parallel target verification ( Xia et al., 2023 ; Leviathan et al., 2023 ; Chen et al., 2023 ) . Its efficiency depends on accepted length relative to drafting and verification costs ( Xia et al., 2024 ) . Prior work develops feature-level autoregressive drafting ( Li et al., 2024b ) and blockwise parallel prediction ( Stern et al., 2018 ) . DFlash combines target-feature conditioning with block diffusion to predict draft tokens in one backbone pass ( Chen et al., 2026 ) . DSpark retains parallel backbone computation and adds lightweight sequential correction for adjacent-token dependencies ( Cheng et al., 2026 ) . We study how coordinated training and inference can turn this inexpensive block computation into longer accepted continuations.
blocks.zh: 光谱解码通过将廉价的建议书生成与平行目标核查区分开来,降低了语言模型推断的相继成本(Xia等,2023;Leviathan等,2023;Chen等,2023)。 其效率取决于相对于起草和核查费用的公认长度(Xia等,2024年)。 之前的工作开发出地物级自递回式(Li等,2024b)和块相平行预测(Stern等,2018. DFlash将目标地貌调节与块扩散相结合,以预测一个骨干通关(Chen等,2026. DSpark保留了平行的骨干计算,并增加了相邻的吻合依赖的轻量级相继校正(Cheng等,2026). 我们研究协调的培训和推论如何将这种廉价的区块计算转化为更长久的被接受的续作.

blocks.en: Low drafting latency alone does not ensure efficient use of a predicted block. With a single proposed continuation, the first rejection discards the remaining suffix regardless of its local prediction quality ( Leviathan et al., 2023 ; Chen et al., 2023 ) . For a parallel drafter, computation has already been spent on every block position, but later predictions contribute only when the required prefix remains available. DSpark models adjacent-token dependencies, but selecting one continuation still excludes alternatives represented in its distributions. Its correction head is trained on reference parent tokens and encounters model-generated parents at deployment ( Cheng et al., 2026 ) . Accurate reference predictions therefore need not yield useful candidates under the deployed policy. Improving acceptance requires considering both the available continuations and the supervision that shapes them.
blocks.zh: 仅靠低起草延迟并不能确保预测区块的有效利用。 单项提议续作后,第一个拒绝者抛弃了剩余的后缀,不管其局部预测质量如何(Leviathan等,2023;Chen等,2023.). 对于一个平行的起草者来说,计算已经用在了每个块位置上,但后来的预测只有在需要的前缀仍然可用时才会有所贡献. DSpark模型相邻-token依赖,但选择一个续作仍然排除了其分布中所代表的替代品. 其校正负责人接受过参考母标志培训,并在部署时遇到模范父母(Cheng等,2026年)。 因此,根据部署的政策,准确的参考预测不需要产生有用的候选人。 提高接受程度既需要考虑现有的延续,也需要考虑形成这些延续的监督。

blocks.en: A budgeted candidate tree retains alternatives while reusing parallel computation. Tree verification evaluates continuations with shared prefixes in one target pass ( Miao et al., 2024 ; Cai et al., 2024 ) , with candidate allocation constrained by verification cost ( Chen et al., 2024 ) . In the semi-autoregressive architecture, shared backbone outputs support lightweight parent-dependent corrections. This extension creates a specific learning requirement: each depth-specific prediction must support several proposed parents, and only a subset of their children receives verification positions. Reference-token losses do not directly supervise this allocation. Useful alternatives may fall below local selection boundaries or lose their prefixes during pruning. Training must therefore account for both local prediction quality and the selection decisions that determine complete-path availability.
blocks.zh: 已编入预算的候选树保留替代品,同时重新使用并行计算。 树质核查评价一个目标通关(Miao等,2024;Cai等,2024)中共用前缀的续作,候选人分配受核查费用限制(Chen等,2024.). 在半自动后退架构中,共享骨干输出支持轻量级亲子依赖的校正. 这种扩展产生了具体的学习要求:每个深度特定的预测必须支持几个被推荐的父母,只有他们的孩子的子集获得核实位置. 参考损失不直接监督这一分配。 有用的替代品可能低于本地选择的边界,或者在修剪过程中失去前缀. 因此,培训必须考虑到当地预测质量和确定是否具备完全路径的选择决定。

blocks.en: Draft-generated data and online distillation improve alignment with inference-time continuations and query distributions ( Zhou et al., 2024 ; Liu et al., 2024 ) . HASS and EAGLE-3 expose training to simulated inference states ( Zhang et al., 2025 ; Li et al., 2025 ) , while LK losses optimize speculative acceptance directly ( Samarin et al., 2026 ) . Our focus is the additional alignment required when a semi-autoregressive drafter retains multiple continuations. The correction head must learn on proposed parents, reinforce retained paths, and promote useful alternatives under the deployed budget. Sharing the backbone and reusing reference target distributions make this feasible without repeated transformer computation or new target evaluations on every branch.
blocks.zh: 草案生成的数据和在线蒸馏可以更好地与推断时间的延续和查询分布相匹配(周等,2024;刘等,2024.). HASS和EAGLE-3将培训暴露为模拟推论状态(Zhang等,2025;Li等,2025;LK损失则直接优化投机接受(Samarin等,2026)。 我们的焦点是当一个半自动后退的起草器保留了多个续作时所需的额外对接. 教管主任必须了解拟议父母的情况,加强保留的道路,并在部署的预算下推广有用的替代办法。 共享主干并重用参考目标分布使得这成为可行,无需在每个分支重复进行变压器计算或新的目标评价.

blocks.en: We introduce TreeSpark, which integrates parent-conditioned candidate generation with training under the deployed policy (Figure 1 ). Training replays expansion, pruning, and packing with the current drafter while retaining reference distillation. Survival weights retained-edge likelihood by reference-derived path mass; capped coverage promotes target-important alternatives near local selection boundaries, including omitted candidates. Both losses update the shared backbone and Markov head on model-generated parents, with discrete selection held fixed. Reference target distributions are reused across branches. Deployment follows the same candidate policy with greedy verification and one draft backbone pass per round. The deployment policy defines the states and selections used for supervision. Learning can therefore improve the candidates presented to a fixed verifier without introducing a separate scoring model at inference.
blocks.zh: 我们引入了TreatySpark,它根据部署的政策(图1)将父母有条件的一代候选人与培训相结合。 训练在保留参考蒸馏的同时,重放扩展,打磨,并用目前的起草器包装. 按参考来源路径质量计算的生存权重保留了极小的可能性;上限覆盖范围可促进接近当地选择界限的重要目标替代品,包括略去的候选人。 这两个损失都更新了模型生成的父母的共享骨干和Markov头部,并固定了离散选择。 参考目标分布跨分支再利用. 部署工作遵循同样的候选人政策,进行贪婪的核查,每轮1个骨干通行证草稿。 部署政策规定了用于监督的州和选择。 因此,学习可以改进提交给固定核查员的候选人,而不必在推论中引入单独的评分模式。

blocks.en: The main contributions are: • A unified extension of semi-autoregressive drafting that retains alternative continuations with one backbone pass and trains on model-generated parent states by replaying the deployed expansion, pruning, and packing policy. • Complementary survival and coverage objectives that weight retained-edge likelihood by reference-derived path mass and promote useful alternatives near local selection boundaries, reusing reference target distributions without additional target forward passes. • Evaluations against DFlash and DSpark on two Qwen3 targets, with mean single-request throughput gains of 15.1% to 25.0% over DSpark. Controls at fixed attention capacity and inference policy isolate the additional benefit of supervision.
blocks.zh: 主要贡献是: 统一扩展半自动回放起草,通过重放部署的扩展,跑道和包装政策,保留一个主干通道的替代续作,并在模型生成的母州进行列车. • 补充生存和覆盖目标,即通过参考衍生路径质量衡量保留的可能性,并在当地选择边界附近推广有用的替代品,在不增加目标前行通行证的情况下重新使用参考目标分布。 • 针对DFlash和DSpark两个Qune3目标的评价,平均单一请求的吞吐量比DSpark增加15.1%至25.0%。 固定注意力能力的控制和推断政策隔离了监督的额外好处。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Blockwise parallel decoding predicts several positions before validating their longest usable prefix ( Stern et al., 2018 ) . EAGLE instead drafts target features autoregressively ( Li et al., 2024b ) . DFlash combines target-feature conditioning with a lightweight block diffusion drafter, reducing proposal generation to one backbone pass ( Chen et al., 2026 ) . DSpark augments this structure with sequential token correction and confidence-based verification scheduling ( Cheng et al., 2026 ) . These methods motivate our focus on increasing accepted length while retaining parallel backbone computation. TreeSpark builds on the DSpark Markov-head architecture and couples the generation of alternative continuations with supervision on the parent states and candidate selections used at deployment.
blocks.zh: Blockwise平行解码在验证其可使用时间最长的前缀之前预测出多个位置(Stern等,2018年). EAGLE转而自动地起草目标特征(Li等,2024b.). DFlash将目标地平面调节与轻量级块扩散起草器相结合,将提案生成降至一个主干道通(Chen等,2026). DSpark通过顺序符号更正和基于信任的核查时间安排来增强这一结构(Cheng等,2026年)。 这些方法促使我们注重增加接受的长度,同时保留平行的主干计算。 TreeSpark以DSpark Markov-head架构为基础,并配对生成替代续作,监督母州和部署时使用的候选人选择.

blocks.en: DistillSpec studies draft-generated data and decoding-specific distillation ( Zhou et al., 2024 ) , while Online Speculative Decoding updates the drafter from verification feedback ( Liu et al., 2024 ) . HASS aligns training with speculative rollout ( Zhang et al., 2025 ) , EAGLE-3 simulates inference during training ( Li et al., 2025 ) , and LK losses directly optimize speculative acceptance ( Samarin et al., 2026 ) . DFlash also aligns masked-block construction with its inference inputs. TreeSpark extends alignment to the candidate decisions introduced by branching: survival supervises retained paths, and coverage addresses alternatives near the admission boundary. Both objectives reuse reference target distributions while training the parallel backbone and correction head on proposed parent states.
blocks.zh: DistillSpec研究了草稿生成的数据和解码特有蒸馏(周等,2024年),而在线分解解从核查反馈中更新了起草者(刘等,2024年). HASS将培训与投机性推广(Zhang等,2025年),EAGLE-3在培训期间模拟推论(Li等,2025年),LK损失直接优化投机性接受(Samarin等,2026年)。 DFlash还将被遮住的块构造与其推论投入相配合. TreeSpark扩展了与分支引入的候选决定的对接:生存监督保留路径,覆盖范围涉及录取边界附近的替代品. 这两项目标都重复使用参考指标分布,同时对拟议母体国家的平行骨干和矫正头进行培训。

blocks.en: SpecInfer and Medusa establish efficient verification of multiple continuations ( Miao et al., 2024 ; Cai et al., 2024 ) . EAGLE-2 and OPT-Tree adapt candidate allocation ( Li et al., 2024a ; Wang et al., 2025 ) ; Sequoia and CaDDTree account for verification efficiency and cost ( Chen et al., 2024 ; Zhang et al., 2026 ) . DDTree constructs trees from block-diffusion marginals, TAPS learns a target-aware scorer for prefix selection, and JetSpec trains a causal parallel drafter by distillation ( Ringel and Romano, 2026 ; Wang et al., 2026 ; Hu et al., 2026 ) . TreeSpark retains the DSpark semi-autoregressive architecture and replays deployment selections during training, coupling likelihood supervision on retained paths with local admission signals for useful alternatives.
blocks.zh: SpecInfer和Medusa对多种续作建立有效的核查(Miao等人,2024;Cai等人,2024;EAGLE-2和OPC-Tree调整候选人分配办法(Li等人,2024a); Wang等,2025; Sequoia和CADDTree的核查效率和成本核算(Chen等,2024;Zhang等,2026)。 DDTree从块状分流边缘构造出树木,TAPS为前缀选择学习有目标意识的分数器,JetSpec通过分馏来训练出一个因果平行的起草器(Ringel and Romano, 2026;Wang等人, 2026;Hu等人, 2026). TreeSpark保留了DSpark半自动回放架构,并在训练中重放部署选择,将保留路径上的可能性监督与当地的录取信号相配合,以获取有用的替代品.

blocks.en: TreeSpark extends the DSpark parallel backbone and lightweight correction head through coordinated training and inference (Figure 1 ). Inference retains alternative continuations in a bounded tree, and training replays the same candidate policy on model-generated parent states. Survival supervises retained edges, while coverage addresses local candidate admission before packing. The joint objective updates the backbone and Markov head with discrete selection held fixed. We first define candidate generation, then describe its replay and supervision.
blocks.zh: TreeSpark通过协调的培训和推论(图1)来扩展DSpark平行骨干和轻量级的校正头. 推论在有界树上保留了可选续作,而训练则在模型生成的母州重放同样的候选政策. 生存监督保留边缘,而覆盖范围则涉及在包装前接纳当地候选人的问题。 联合目标更新了骨干和Markov头部,并固定了独立的选择。 我们首先定义候选一代,然后描述它的再演和监督.

blocks.en: Tree construction uses a local branching factor k k , frontier width k k , and budget N N of non-root nodes. Starting from the anchor, each frontier parent proposes its top- k k children. Every child enters a candidate pool and receives the product of draft conditional probabilities along its path as its score. The k k highest-scoring children at that depth form the next frontier. After B B depths, global packing retains up to N N highest-scoring nodes from the pool, preferring shallower nodes when scores tie. Frontier pruning bounds expansion cost, whereas global packing determines the input to target verification.

blocks.en: The resulting tree contains every ancestor of each selected node: a child has no larger path probability than its parent, and the tie rule places the parent first. Tree attention then lets each node attend to the committed prefix and its own ancestor path. Greedy verification follows children that match the target argmax and emits a target-selected bonus token when the matching path ends. Under identical per-path target evaluations and argmax tie rules, this procedure preserves autoregressive greedy output for any such tree. Appendix A gives the construction and correctness arguments.

blocks.en: We use Qwen3-4B and Qwen3-8B targets ( Yang et al., 2025 ) with greedy decoding. All drafters are trained for ten epochs on a common mixture of 50,000 prompts covering mathematics, code, dialogue, and writing, with a maximum training sequence length of 4,096 tokens. Evaluation retains complete input prompts and generates up to 2,048 tokens. The general suite comprises nine reasoning, coding, and dialogue benchmarks; WritingBench supplies six writing domains ( Wu et al., 2025 ) . Writing training prompts come from Writer-R1 ( Zhao et al., 2026 ) and are disjoint from WritingBench. Appendix E.1 details the datasets and training settings.

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion

blocks.en: TreeSpark demonstrates how a deployment policy can guide the training of a parallel drafter. Training on model-generated parent states under the deployed selection policy directs reference supervision toward the continuations available for target verification. The controlled comparison yields longer mean accepted paths and higher mean throughput at fixed attention capacity and inference policy. This evidence supports treating candidate admission and prefix retention as integral to draft learning, alongside reference prediction accuracy. The resulting extension of DFlash and DSpark preserves shared backbone computation while improving how its predictions are used. These findings motivate draft objectives that account for the states and selection constraints encountered during candidate generation and verification.
blocks.zh: TreeSpark展示了部署政策如何指导平行起草员的培训。 根据已部署的甄选政策,对模式产生的母国进行培训,指导参照监督工作,以继续用于目标核查。 控制下的比较产生较长的时间,意味着在固定注意力能力和推论政策下接受路径和较高的平均吞吐量。 这些证据支持将考生录取和保留前缀与参考预测准确性一起作为学习草稿的组成部分。 由此产生的DFlash和DSpark的扩展保留了共享骨干计算,同时改善了其预测的使用方式. 这些结论激励了目标草案,考虑到了各州和在候选人产生和核实过程中遇到的甄选限制。

blocks.en: WritingBench ( Wu et al., 2025 ) covers Academic and Engineering, Advertising and Marketing, Education, Finance and Business, Literature and Arts, and Politics and Law. We evaluate all 1,000 prompts, with 167, 128, 111, 210, 183, and 201 in the respective domains. During preparation, writing training prompts were filtered against evaluation prompts using n n -gram overlap with n = 3 n=3 . A training prompt was removed if its shared trigrams accounted for at least 10% of the trigrams in any compared evaluation prompt. Normalization uses the evaluation prompt, making the overlap criterion directional. An additional exact-text comparison of the final training file against all WritingBench prompts finds no matches. Domain means weight these six groups equally, independently of their sizes.

blocks.en: For both targets, all drafters use ten training epochs with AdamW, a learning rate of 6 × 10 − 4 6\times 10^{-4} , 4% warmup, bfloat16 computation, and global batch size 64. Drafter depth follows Section 4.1 : one layer for EAGLE-3 and five for DFlash, DSpark, and TreeSpark. Results use the final checkpoint. TreeSpark retains the reference losses and adds the two auxiliary terms with the coefficients specified in Appendix D . These settings are also retained in DSpark + Tree and the single-loss ablations; the compared tree policy and serving implementation remain fixed. Evaluation applies no input-length truncation and limits generated output to 2,048 tokens; the 2,048-token prompt filter is used only when constructing the training mixture.

blocks.en: The main comparisons evaluate the extension of parallel drafting under the common protocol in Section 4.1 . EAGLE-3 supplies an autoregressive-drafter reference in its evaluated chain configuration. DSpark + Tree is a reference-trained control with the same attention head dimension of 192 and the same inference policy as TreeSpark; it disables both tree losses. Single-loss ablations set only the corresponding coefficient to zero. The capacity ablation uses head dimension 128 with both objectives and the candidate policy retained.
blocks.zh: 主要比较评价了第4.1节中共同协议下并行起草的延伸. EAGLE-3在其评价的链式配置中提供了自旋式起草器参考. DSpark + Tree是一种经过参考训练的控制,注意头维为192,与TreeSpark的推论政策相同;它可以使两棵树都失去功能. 单损平面只将相应的系数设定为零. 能力缩减采用第128个层面,同时保留目标和候选人政策。

blocks.en: For each dataset, acceptance length is the total number of newly committed tokens divided by the number of verification rounds. The anchor is excluded. The target bonus is included when emitted, while termination by an accepted end token or an output limit can shorten the final round. The eight-position block convention therefore corresponds to seven draft depths and at most eight newly committed tokens in an ordinary round. A tree budget of 32 counts non-root candidates; its target input has up to 33 positions including the anchor.
blocks.zh: 对于每个数据集,接受长度是新承诺的符号总数除以核查回合数. 锚被排除在外。 目标奖金在发放时包含在内,被接受的结束符或产出限制的终止可以缩短最后一轮. 因此,八地块公约相当于7个深度草案,最多相当于8个普通回合新承诺的代币。 由32名非基层候选人构成的树形预算;其目标投入多达33个职位,包括锚地。

blocks.en: The position-wise metric at draft position j j divides the number of rounds that accept at least j + 1 j+1 draft tokens by the number that propose that position. It is cumulative over accepted depth. The left panel of Figure 2 averages recorded rates at C = 12 C=12 across the nine general benchmarks; shading shows their range across tasks. These rates and aggregate acceptance lengths come from separate evaluation records. The right panel therefore uses the directly recorded lengths in Table 2 , including their termination behavior. Figure 3 uses the same means of 4.23 for DSpark and 5.25 for TreeSpark, together with the suite-level DSpark + Tree aggregate of 4.93. Benchmark-level lengths and position-wise rates are not reported for this control. Acceptance length is measured in tokens per verification round, separately from throughput in tokens per second.

blocks.en: Single-request throughput divides total output tokens by accumulated decoding time. The concurrency experiment uses a closed loop that admits a new request whenever a slot becomes free. System throughput divides all generated tokens by the elapsed workload time. For multiple cards, output counts are summed across workers and elapsed time is the maximum worker duration. At total concurrency 36, three workers each maintain up to 12 active requests. Each worker hosts its own model replica; the comparison measures aggregate serving throughput across these replicas.
blocks.zh: 单请求吞吐量将总输出令牌除以累积的解码时间. 货币实验使用一个闭合的循环,当一个槽变得自由时,该循环会接受新的请求. 系统吞吐量将所有生成的信号按已过的工作量时间划分。 对于多张卡片,产出计数由工人进行总和,经过的时间是工人最长的工作时间。 总货币36, 3名工人每人维持12项主动请求。 每个工人都拥有自己的模型复制品;比较测量了这些复制品的服务吞吐量。

blocks.en: Per-request throughput is computed from each request after its first output token: subsequent output tokens are divided by the interval from first-token emission to completion, and the resulting rates are averaged across requests. It excludes time to first token and need not equal system throughput divided by nominal concurrency. Prefill, the filling and draining of active slots, and variable completion times affect the two measurements differently.
blocks.zh: 每项请求的吞吐量是在其第一个产出符号之后从每个请求中计算出来的:随后的产出符号除以从先入先出的排放到完成的间隔,所产生的速率按请求平均计算。 它排除了先兆的时间,不需要以名义货币除以相等的系统吞吐量。 预填,活性槽的填充和排出以及可变的完成时间对两种测量的影响不同.

blocks.en: Within each target and workload group, Mean is the unweighted arithmetic mean of the benchmark metrics. In throughput tables, the Mean entry in a Δ \Delta row averages the relative improvement on each benchmark. In Tables 2 and 6 , the corresponding entry instead compares the two mean acceptance lengths. Figure 3 displays arithmetic mean absolute metrics. Gains between tree configurations compare these means: this convention applies to the 4.2% and 5.0% throughput gains over DSpark + Tree and the 2.0% system and 2.1% per-request gains from increasing head dimension. The approximate 6.4% acceptance gain uses the unrounded TreeSpark mean and the available DSpark + Tree aggregate of 4.93. Other aggregates are calculated from benchmark-level observations before rounding for presentation.

Relative gains over DSpark range from 30.3% to 32.4% for Qwen3-4B and from 29.5% to 32.6% for Qwen3-8B, showing that the higher mean acceptance extends across the writing suite. Together with the writing throughput results in Table 1 , these measurements establish that longer accepted paths translate into faster generation on these workloads. blocks.en: The per-request ablations in Table 8 support the component analysis in the main text. The full configuration improves throughput over DSpark by an average of 17.6%. Removing survival reduces this gain to 12.8%; removing coverage reduces it to 15.0%; retaining head dimension 128 yields 15.3%. The corresponding mean system throughput increases by 2.0%. The complete configuration has the highest per-request throughput on each benchmark in this ablation. Together with Table 4 , these results support combining tree supervision with the larger attention representation.

blocks.en: The improvement from aligned supervision is positive in aggregate and varies by task. The reference-trained control has higher system throughput on AIME 2025, MBPP, and ArenaHard-v2 at C = 12 C=12 , and on GSM8K, MT-Bench, and ArenaHard-v2 at C = 36 C=36 . blocks.en: The experiments assess the proposed extension of parallel drafting with two Qwen3 target sizes, greedy decoding, and a fixed candidate budget. Comparisons with DFlash and DSpark measure complete-system efficiency; the reference-trained branching control and ablations assess the contribution of training alignment and capacity. Greedy output preservation is established under the verification assumptions in Appendix A . Generalization across budgets and stochastic sampling remains to be evaluated.
blocks.zh: 实验评估了并行起草的拟议延长,有两个Quen3的目标尺寸,贪婪地解码,以及固定的候选预算. 与DFlash和DSpark的比较衡量整个系统的效率;参考训练分校控制和分校评估培训调整和能力的贡献。 贪婪的产出保全是根据附录A中的核查假设确定的。 跨预算的概况和有条理的抽样仍有待评估。
